nodes.description: Owner address stored in Ownable; gates all onlyOwner privileged configuration functions.
Flag controlling whether non-excluded accounts may trade; can only be enabled, never disabled.

Flag gating max transaction / max wallet / transfer-delay anti-whale checks in _transfer.
Flag enabling the one-purchase-per-block delay keyed on tx.origin.
Re-entrancy guard set to true around swapBack() and used to disable fee taking.
Recipient of marketing ETH share; receives the whole remaining contract balance via low-level call.

Maximum amount allowed per buy/sell when limits are active.
Maximum balance any non-excluded wallet may hold.
Token balance threshold on the contract that triggers swapBack.
ERC20 balance ledger mutated by _transfer and _mint.
ERC20 allowance ledger used by _approve before router interactions.
Accounts exempt from fee taking and from the trading-active gate.
Accounts exempt from max transaction and max wallet limits.

Stores last block number per tx.origin to enforce one purchase per block.
Accumulated fee tokens allocated to liquidity; reset in swapBack.
Accumulated fee tokens allocated to marketing; reset in swapBack.
Accumulated fee tokens allocated to dev; reset in swapBack.

Immutable CATOPIA/WETH pair address; target of LP burn operations.

Basis points (of 10000) of the LP balance burned by autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.

Approves and adds token/ETH liquidity to the router, sending LP tokens to deadAddress.
Owner-only manual LP token burn with rate limit and cooldown.
Internal automatic LP token burn then pair.sync().
Modifier restricting callers to _owner; the sole access control for privileged setters.
Owner-only setter for maxTransactionAmount with a lower bound check.
Owner-only setter for swapTokensAtAmount bounded between 0.001% and 0.5% of supply.
Owner-only toggling of _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount.
Owner-only setter of buy-side fee components, capped at 20%.
Owner-only setter of sell-side fee components, capped at 100%.
Owner-only toggling of fee exclusion for an account.
Owner-only addition of an AMM pair; removal of the main pair is blocked.
Owner-only replacement of marketingWallet without zero-address validation.
Owner-only replacement of devWallet without zero-address validation.
Owner-only renunciation that sets _owner to the zero address.
Owner-only transfer of _owner to a new address.
Owner-only setter for maxWallet with a lower bound check.
Owner-only function that enables tradingActive and swapEnabled permanently.
Low-level call forwarding ethForDev ETH to devWallet with ignored success flag.
Low-level call sending the entire remaining contract ETH balance to marketingWallet.
External router swap with zero slippage protection and block.timestamp deadline.
External router addLiquidityETH with zero min amounts and block.timestamp deadline.
External call to IUniswapV2Pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
State write _holderLastTransferTimestamp[tx.origin] = block.number using tx.origin as authorization key.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, ownership and transfer origin.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as router deadline and as the LP burn cooldown reference.
Origin address used as the key for the per-block transfer delay mapping.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Token amount parameter of _transfer, reduced by fees before the final transfer.
Local copy of the contract token balance read at the start of the swap check.
Boolean derived from comparing contractTokenBalance with swapTokensAtAmount.
Local flag deciding whether buy/sell fees are applied.
Local computed fee amount split among liquidity, dev and marketing buckets.
New swap threshold supplied to updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
New limit value supplied to updateMaxTxnAmount.
Account address supplied to excludeFromMaxTransaction.
Boolean exclusion flag supplied to excludeFromFees.
Replacement marketing wallet address supplied by the owner.

Sum of the three pending fee token buckets used as the swap denominator.
Half of the liquidity share of tokens kept back for addLiquidity.

edges.reason: msg.sender (via _msgSender) is supplied as the from argument of _transfer.
The constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline.
The manual LP burn cooldown check depends on block.timestamp.
lastManualLpBurnTime is assigned from block.timestamp.
tx.origin is used as the key of the per-block transfer delay mapping.
The transfer-delay state write is authorized by tx.origin rather than msg.sender.
_transfer invokes swapBack when the contract balance threshold is met.
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) into contractTokenBalance.
canSwap is computed by comparing contractTokenBalance against swapTokensAtAmount.
The swapping flag is set before swapBack and cleared after, acting as a reentrancy guard.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert fee tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity with the retained liquidity tokens.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet before completing its accounting.
swapBack performs a final low-level ETH call to marketingWallet with the entire remaining balance.
swapTokensForEth hands control to the external Uniswap router with zero slippage protection.
addLiquidity hands control to the external router with zero minimum amounts.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls the external pair.sync().
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls the external pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
devWallet address taken from storage is the target of the low-level ETH call.
marketingWallet address taken from storage is the target of the final low-level ETH call.
The locally computed ethForDev amount is the value sent in the low-level call.
fees is derived from the amount parameter using mul/div against the total fee rates.
amount is decremented by fees before the final super._transfer.
The liquidity share of fees is accumulated into tokensForLiquidity.
The marketing share of fees is accumulated into tokensForMarketing.
The dev share of fees is accumulated into tokensForDev.
Owner-only setter writes maxTransactionAmount from an unvalidated upper range.
Owner-only setter writes swapTokensAtAmount within supply-relative bounds.
onlyOwner modifier guards updateMaxTxnAmount.
onlyOwner modifier guards updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
onlyOwner modifier guards excludeFromFees.
onlyOwner modifier guards setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
onlyOwner modifier guards updateMarketingWallet.
onlyOwner modifier guards updateDevWallet.
onlyOwner modifier guards manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
renounceOwnership clears _owner, permanently removing all privileged functionality.
transferOwnership reassigns _owner and therefore the entire privileged control set.
marketingWallet is replaced by an owner-supplied address with no zero-address check.
devWallet is replaced by an owner-supplied address with no zero-address check.
Owner-controlled pair registration flips automatedMarketMakerPairs fee logic.
Owner-controlled fee exclusion flips _isExcludedFromFees.
Owner-only write to _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount removes limits for an address.
amountToBurn is computed from the pair balance and the requested percent.
The percent parameter scales the LP burn amount.
maxTransactionAmount is read by _transfer to bound buy/sell size.
maxWallet is read by _transfer to bound recipient balances.
_isExcludedFromFees gates fee taking and the trading-active requirement.
automatedMarketMakerPairs determines buy versus sell fee branches.
limitsInEffect gates the anti-whale and transfer delay checks.
transferDelayEnabled gates the tx.origin per-block restriction.
contractBalance participates in the totalTokensToSwap denominator computation.
totalTokensToSwap is the divisor used to compute the developer ETH share.
amountToSwapForETH is the input token amount for the router swap.
tradingActive gates transfers unless sender or recipient is fee-excluded.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is a non-core input consumed directly by the _transfer function.
The to parameter is a non-core input consumed directly by the _transfer function.
The amount parameter is consumed and reduced by fees inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a local computed inside _transfer for the swap threshold check.
canSwap is the local guard whose truth decides whether swapBack executes.
takeFee is a local flag within _transfer controlling fee application.
fees is the local fee amount computed and applied inside _transfer.
newAmount is the parameter of updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is the parameter of updateMaxTxnAmount.
updAds is the parameter of excludeFromMaxTransaction.
excluded is the parameter of excludeFromFees.
newMarketingWallet is the parameter of updateMarketingWallet.
contractBalance is the local contract balance computed inside swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is the local denominator computed inside swapBack.
liquidityTokens is the local retained-liquidity amount computed inside swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is the token amount fed into the router swap operation.
ethForMarketing is the local value routed to the marketing wallet low-level call.
ethForDev is the local value routed to the dev wallet low-level call.
ethForLiquidity is the local ETH amount handed to addLiquidity.
percent is the parameter of manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
amountToBurn is the local burn amount computed inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
